extracted.name: Classic Slow Cooker Corn Chowder
extracted.description: A comforting and creamy corn chowder with potatoes and ham is made in the slow cooker. Chili powder and hot sauce adds a little kick.
ingredient_lines: 2 (10.75 ounce) cans condensed cream of mushroom soup
2 cups frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Stir milk, cream-style corn, cream of mushroom soup, chopped green chiles, frozen corn, hash brown potatoes, ham, onion, butter, hot sauce, parsley, and chili powder in a slow cooker. Season with salt and black pepper. Cover and cook on High for 4 hours or on Low and for 6 hours.
